decisive_items: heterogeneous, focally hyperdense lesion of the left middle turbinate
purulent rhinorrhea and a markedly hypertrophic left middle turbinate with granulomatous mucosa
response.rationale: Diabetes mellitus and chronic purulent sinusitis unresponsive to antibiotics favor invasive fungal sinusitis; CT hyperdensity and granulomatous mucosa support fungal etiology, while lack of bony erosion and 3-month course align with chronic invasive form. R2 is a more specific subtype but lacks the hyperdense lesion and diabetes emphasis.

rejected.why: No atopy or allergic stigmata; diabetes and purulence point to invasive rather than allergic fungal disease.
Granulomatous mucosa alone is nonspecific; no systemic vasculitis features or bony destruction typical of GPA.
Descriptive label without distinct diagnostic criteria; less specific than fungal sinusitis.
Antibiotic failure and suspected fungal etiology contradict chronic bacterial sinusitis.
